causes.text: a token starting with '-' that is not a documented spelling (unknown long flag, misspelled or upper-case spelling, single-dash form of a long option)
a flag that takes no value is given one with '=' (e.g. --sort=1)
the FILE argument does not exist (also an empty-string argument and a dangling symlink)
the FILE argument is a directory
the FILE argument is not readable
--width is followed by another option, which is not taken as its value
